test_title: PYST 15: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

He told me, “I will call you later.”

options.text: He told me that he would call me later.
He told me I would call me later.
He told he can call me later.
He told you call me later.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In indirect speech, the pronoun **"I" **changes to** "he" or "she"** depending on the subject.
 
• The verb** "will" **changes to **"would" **in indirect speech.
 
• The structure of the sentence changes to accommodate these shifts while maintaining the original meaning.
 
• Therefore, the indirect speech version of **"I will call you later" **is **"he would call me later."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
